title: prd-to-tickets: tiers chain by blocks, the UX prototype gates the cut, pending ADRs are read, and its own pull requests merge on green
summary: prd-to-tickets blocks every later-tier story on the final stories of the tier before (both forms, read back), stops after opening a prototype PR for missing screens (and stops again on rerun while it is open), reads pending ADRs beside the PRD, and quotes the baseline Who-merges rule. Version 27.
deferred: wayfinder still files a 'UX prototype for <screen>' story when a screen is missing; check it against the UX-gate decision (likely covered by the wayfinder prototype-order story, issue #177).
